mcp.name: atlas_config
mcp.description: Return the effective ProjectAtlas scan, purpose, and output configuration.

mcp.name: atlas_file_summary
mcp.description: Return structured TOON file intelligence: file purpose, content summary, imports, symbols, line ranges, and calls.

mcp.name: atlas_files
mcp.description: Rank repository files by query, purpose, optional folder, and optional indexed text fallback before an agent opens source.

mcp.name: atlas_folders
mcp.description: Rank repository folders by query and purpose so agents choose a work area before opening files.

mcp.name: atlas_health
mcp.description: Return a bounded ProjectAtlas structural health page with optional category, severity, and path-prefix filters.

mcp.name: atlas_health_resolve
mcp.description: Mark a deterministic ProjectAtlas health finding as agent-resolved with rationale.

mcp.name: atlas_ignore_add
mcp.description: Add one manual ProjectAtlas ignore entry to the selected project's config.

mcp.name: atlas_ignore_init_gitignore
mcp.description: Create a project-root .gitignore when it is missing.

mcp.name: atlas_ignore_list
mcp.description: List effective ProjectAtlas manual ignore policy and inherited .gitignore status.

mcp.name: atlas_ignore_remove
mcp.description: Remove one manual ProjectAtlas ignore entry from the selected project's config.

mcp.name: atlas_init
mcp.description: Initialize ProjectAtlas project-local config, database, host MCP configs, scan/index, and purpose handoff.

mcp.name: atlas_lint
mcp.description: Run ProjectAtlas lint checks and return an ok flag, CLI-compatible exit code, and report text.

mcp.name: atlas_map
mcp.description: Write the explicit compatibility ProjectAtlas map export for older workflows.

mcp.name: atlas_mcp_config
mcp.description: Return a generated ProjectAtlas MCP config document for mcp-json, codex, claude-code, or opencode hosts.

mcp.name: atlas_next
mcp.description: Recommend top indexed folders/files with reasons and deterministic follow-up commands for a task query.

mcp.name: atlas_outline
mcp.description: Return compact TOON outline and preview context for a selected file.

mcp.name: atlas_overview
mcp.description: Return a compact TOON overview of indexed files, folders, and purpose coverage.

mcp.name: atlas_parity_report
mcp.description: Return a ProjectAtlas repository-intelligence parity gate report for release and agent-runtime readiness.

mcp.name: atlas_purpose_queue
mcp.description: Return a bounded folder-first queue of ProjectAtlas paths that need agent purpose curation.

mcp.name: atlas_purpose_review
mcp.description: Preview or apply agent-reviewed ProjectAtlas purpose metadata for multiple indexed paths.

mcp.name: atlas_purpose_set
mcp.description: Set agent-approved ProjectAtlas purpose metadata for one indexed path.

mcp.name: atlas_reset_index
mcp.description: Preview or clear ProjectAtlas local SQLite index/cache files for recovery.

mcp.name: atlas_root
mcp.description: Show or verify ProjectAtlas root, DB, config, and runtime identity.

mcp.name: atlas_root_set
mcp.description: Bind a repository root, generate project-local MCP configs, and make it active for later MCP calls.

mcp.name: atlas_runtime_info
mcp.description: Return ProjectAtlas runtime identity, version, capabilities, and compiled MCP tool names.

mcp.name: atlas_scan
mcp.description: Scan repository structure, import ProjectAtlas purpose metadata, rebuild symbols, and return a TOON overview.

mcp.name: atlas_search
mcp.description: Search indexed files with literal, regex, or fuzzy matching, file filters, pagination, and TOON results.

mcp.name: atlas_session_brief
mcp.description: Return selected project identity, index state, ranked candidates, blockers, and typed next-call recommendations for agent startup.

mcp.name: atlas_set_project_path
mcp.description: Select the active ProjectAtlas project root for later MCP calls that omit project_path.

mcp.name: atlas_settings
mcp.description: Return ProjectAtlas local settings, config, and durable index paths.

mcp.name: atlas_slice
mcp.description: Return exact source for a selected line range or indexed symbol, after folder/file orientation.

mcp.name: atlas_strip_legacy_purpose
mcp.description: Preview or remove legacy .purpose files after their metadata has been imported to SQLite.

mcp.name: atlas_symbol_relations
mcp.description: List imports, calls, dependencies, and containment edges as compact TOON.

mcp.name: atlas_symbols
mcp.description: List indexed symbols by optional file and query as compact TOON.

mcp.name: atlas_symbols_build
mcp.description: Rebuild ProjectAtlas symbol graphs for indexed files and return a TOON build report.

mcp.name: atlas_task_cancel
mcp.description: Request cancellation for a bounded MCP task-progress record.

mcp.name: atlas_task_status
mcp.description: Return typed status for a bounded MCP task-progress record.

mcp.name: atlas_token_report
mcp.description: Return ProjectAtlas token-savings telemetry for the whole index or one session.

mcp.name: atlas_watch_once
mcp.description: Run one MCP-safe watcher refresh pass over the repository and rebuild changed symbols, with optional worker, timeout, and text-index size controls.

mcp.name: atlas_watch_status
mcp.description: Return ProjectAtlas watcher availability and current operating mode.
